findings.title: reserve_fast missing await on reserve_stock
findings.explanation: reserve_stock is async and must be awaited. Without await, ok is a coroutine which is always truthy, so insufficient-stock check never fires and stock is never decremented, allowing oversell.

evidence.why: reserve_fast calls reserve_stock without await so ok is a coroutine
reserve_stock is async def returning bool and must be awaited

findings.suggestion: Add await: ok = await reserve_stock(sku, quantity).
findings.verifier_note: Verified missing await vs async def; new code in diff, truthy coroutine breaks 409 check.

findings.title: N+1 queries in /orders/details
findings.explanation: New /orders/details does 1 query for list_orders() then 1 additional SELECT per order inside the loop. Query count is 1+N and grows with order count instead of a single batched fetch.

evidence.why: New loop calls db.items_for_order once per order after list_orders
Each items_for_order executes a separate SELECT on order_items
list_orders executes the initial query returning N orders

findings.suggestion: Batch fetch items in one query (e.g. WHERE order_id IN (...) or JOIN) instead of per-order SELECT.
findings.verifier_note: Verified: new endpoint loops list_orders result and issues per-order SELECT; introduced by this diff and fixable by batching.

findings.title: blocking requests.get in async endpoint
findings.explanation: remote_stock is async but calls blocking requests.get, which blocks the event loop and stalls all other requests until the remote call completes.

evidence.why: async endpoint uses blocking requests.get without await

findings.suggestion: Use httpx AsyncClient, or make endpoint sync def, or run blocking call in threadpool.
findings.verifier_note: Verified async def with synchronous requests.get; introduced by diff and blocks event loop.

findings.title: External HTTP request without timeout can hang
findings.explanation: remote_stock performs requests.get to an external URL without a timeout. A slow or hung upstream can block the worker indefinitely, enabling DoS and resource exhaustion.

evidence.why: requests.get with f-string URL has no timeout argument

findings.suggestion: Add explicit timeout, e.g. requests.get(url, timeout=5).
findings.verifier_note: Verified no timeout arg on external GET; new code in diff, fix is adding timeout.
